title: Static GK: Narmada River Hydroelectric Projects & Geography
summary: Longest west-flowing river in India, originating in Maikala range near Amarkantak.

blocks.content: Longest west-flowing river in India, originating in Maikala range near Amarkantak.

items: Geography & Course: Also known as Reva; originates from Amarkantak (MP) and empties into Gulf of Khambhat (Arabian Sea); spans MP, Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Chhattisgarh.
Major Hydropower Projects: Sardar Sarovar Dam (Gujarat), Indira Sagar Dam (MP), Maheshwar Dam, and Omkareshwar Dam.
